name: starving artists (DONATION GAME)
desc:
🎨 Welcome to Starving Artists, a game where you can make or buy art, sell it, and strive to become the most popular artist! Link your clothing to your art for any price, and gain Robux from every sale! When someone buys your art, the painting will be transferred to the buyers in-game inventory to be kept or resold!

🖼️ To create a t-shirt, click HERE! https://www.roblox.com/develop?View=2

⭐ Hey you! Join the group for a very special surprise.. https://www.roblox.com/groups/13751258

Will you become the next artist with the most valuable painting?

Note: Robux can take up to a week to receive!

All content in game, including any sponsored content, was developed, uploaded and published by the game's development team.
